project: Wuxia Life P47 Sample Lines Story Configuration
description: Define and decompose the story-configuration work required to build three 0-40 minimum playable life samples for orthodox martial, demonic edge, and merchant rise using existing content carriers instead of runtime platformization.

userStories.title: Audit existing content anchors for the three sample lines
userStories.description: As a content planner, I want a focused gap audit of existing orthodox, demonic, and merchant anchors so P47 extends real repo content instead of inventing disconnected new arcs.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory current orthodox martial, demonic edge, and merchant rise anchors
Mark which required nodes already exist and which are missing
Save the gap audit under docs/test-reports/
Do not change gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Define the orthodox martial 0-40 chapter spine
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit chapter spine for the orthodox martial sample so later event work serves one coherent life arc instead of scattered martial content.
acceptanceCriteria: Define childhood, youth, early adult, and pre-midlife chapter goals for the orthodox line
List at least 5 key nodes
List at least 2 key choices
List at least 1 upright-cost or fallback node
Record the spine specification in the PRD

userStories.title: Define the demonic edge 0-40 chapter spine
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit chapter spine for the demonic edge sample so the route reads as temptation, gain, and cost rather than flat evil-stat growth.
acceptanceCriteria: Define childhood, youth, early adult, and pre-midlife chapter goals for the demonic line
List at least 5 key nodes
List at least 2 key choices
List at least 1 post-gain cost fallback node
Record the spine specification in the PRD

userStories.title: Define the merchant rise 0-40 chapter spine
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit chapter spine for the merchant rise sample so the route reads as ambition, leverage, and obligation instead of only money gain.
acceptanceCriteria: Define childhood, youth, early adult, and pre-midlife chapter goals for the merchant line
List at least 5 key nodes
List at least 2 key choices
List at least 1 wealth-loyalty or debt-obligation fallback node
Record the spine specification in the PRD

userStories.title: Specify orthodox childhood and youth configuration tasks
userStories.description: As an implementer, I want orthodox early-life work split into small tasks so story configuration can be delivered incrementally instead of as one broad content rewrite.
acceptanceCriteria: Split the orthodox childhood seed into a standalone task
Split the youth first-recognition node into a standalone task
Split the young-adult sect commitment node into a standalone task
Ensure each task can fit in one implementation iteration

userStories.title: Specify demonic childhood and youth configuration tasks
userStories.description: As an implementer, I want demonic early-life work split into small tasks so the corruption arc can be built stepwise and validated locally.
acceptanceCriteria: Split the demonic childhood seed into a standalone task
Split the youth first-transgression node into a standalone task
Split the young-adult temptation node into a standalone task
Ensure each task can fit in one implementation iteration

userStories.title: Specify merchant childhood and youth configuration tasks
userStories.description: As an implementer, I want merchant early-life work split into small tasks so the livelihood arc can be expanded through bounded story slices.
acceptanceCriteria: Split the merchant childhood business seed into a standalone task
Split the youth first-capital node into a standalone task
Split the young-adult caravan or investment fork into a standalone task
Ensure each task can fit in one implementation iteration

userStories.title: Specify midlife cost and identity hooks for all three lines
userStories.description: As a planner, I want the shared midlife-cost and identity-hook work split clearly so later implementation does not stop at youth growth spikes without lifetime consequence.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the orthodox midlife upright-cost hook
Define the demonic midlife reputation, relationship, or health cost hook
Define the merchant midlife wealth-loyalty conflict hook
Define an age-40 identity summary hook for each line
userStories.notes: PRD §16 Midlife Cost And Age-40 Identity Hooks

userStories.title: Define routePoint and flag wiring requirements
userStories.description: As a developer, I want explicit routePoint and flag wiring requirements so content implementation stays compatible with the current runtime instead of drifting into hidden assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the required key flags for each sample line
Define the required routePoints or equivalent carriers for each sample line
Mark which nodes should use mainline, mandatory, or once protection
Record the wiring requirements in the PRD
userStories.notes: PRD §17 RoutePoint And Flag Wiring Requirements

userStories.title: Define P47 closure evidence
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want explicit closure evidence for the configuration stage so later phases know the story spine is stable enough to build on.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the required closure evidence for the configuration stage
List the documents or reports that must be produced
List what remains blocked if the stage is incomplete
Record the closure rules in the PRD
userStories.notes: PRD §18 P47 Closure Evidence; aligns with P46 §11.1
